info.description: A robust microservice backend for managing teams, users, and digital assets.
info.title: Team Management API

post.description: Allows managers or main managers to bulk import users via a CSV file upload.
Invalidates the user's current bearer token server-side.
Creates a new folder with a specified name. The folder will be owned by the requester.

get.description: Retrieves all folders that belong to a user. User can only access their own folders.

delete.description: Deletes a folder by its ID. Only the owner can delete a folder.

post.description: Creates a new note with a title, content, and optional folder. The note will be owned by the requester.

get.description: Retrieves all notes that have been shared with the user.
Retrieves all notes that belong to a user. User can only access their own notes.
Retrieves a note by its ID. Requires read or write access.

put.description: Updates the title, content, or folder of a note. Requires write access.

delete.description: Deletes a note by its ID. Requires owner or write access.

post.description: Shares a note with another user by granting them read or write access. Requires owner or write access.
post.summary: Share a note with another user

delete.description: Removes a user's access to a note. Requires owner or write access.
delete.summary: Remove a user's access to a note

parameters.description: User ID to remove access for
parameters.name: userId

post.description: Allows a manager to create a new team

get.description: Retrieve a team by its unique identifier

put.description: Allows a manager to update a team's information

delete.description: Allows a manager to delete a team

post.description: Allows a manager to add a user to a team

delete.description: Allows a manager to remove a user from a team

put.description: Allows a manager to update a team member's role (member, manager, main_manager)

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token
Creates a new user account with a specified role (manager, member)

get.description: Retrieve all teams associated with a specific user
